title: CREAM : Comparison-Based Reference-Free ELO-Ranked Automatic Evaluation for Meeting Summarization

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the completeness and conciseness scores assigned by LLM evaluators (e.g., GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4o) to their own generated summaries versus human-written gold standard summaries, revealing a tendency for models to assign near-perfect scores to their own outputs.
